caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a natural light brown color. The cabinet consists of an upper and lower section, each with two rectangular paneled doors. The upper section has a simple, straight crown molding at the top, and the corners are accented with vertical panels that extend the full height of the cabinet. Both the upper and lower doors have small, round knobs as handles and are equipped with keyholes, with the hinges placed on the outer sides. The lower part of the cabinet has a slightly more prominent base with bracket feet and additional molding detail. The composition of the drawing presents the cabinet centered on a plain, light beige background, allowing for clear visibility of the cabinet’s features and proportions. There is a small signature near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Triangular Corner Safe
